title: OTA base release info
description: ota-base/<appVersion>/base.json: hashes of the bundles embedded in the binary, written by the base release job (`ota-build base-info`) and read by `ota-cli init`. DESIGN.md 7.1. TypeScript type `BaseInfo` in packages/ota-core/src/types.ts. NOT expressible: the unit key sets of `units` and `sizes.units` must be equal.

releaseTag.description: Git tag of the release, e.g. "v11.9.0".

toolchainImage.description: Pinned CI toolchain image (digest) used to build; "local-unpinned" for local runs.

hbc.description: Hermes compiler used for the embedded bundles; patches must be built with exactly this one.

bytecodeVersion.description: Hermes bytecode (HBC) version, e.g. 96 for RN 0.78.

host.description: Hash of the embedded host bundle per platform.

units.description: Hash of each embedded unit bundle, keyed by unit name.

sizes.description: zstd-compressed size in bytes of each embedded bundle: the base for the size-ratio limits (what shipping the unit in full would cost).

host.description: Host bundle zstd size per platform.

units.description: Unit bundle zstd sizes keyed by unit name.

retired.description: Set by the base release job when the release line leaves the live window.
